thread:
Priya: Quick heads-up: running a 40-min launch messaging wargame tomorrow 09:30 PT. Objective: finalize two benchmark claims, three SDR hooks, and a one-slide rebut matrix vs cloud/APIs/infra. Who can join? :dart:
Dylan: I can make it. I'll bring the latest latency/cost deltas and a short note on routing policies.
Hannah: Count me in. I'll bring P50/P95 graphs for chat load and the canary bench results for quantized models.
Omar: I'll draft the competitor knockouts: where they win (scale, integrations) and where we win (predictable latency, unified runtime, cost controls).
Riley: For SDR hooks let's keep them < 20 words. Suggesting three flavors: PLG, AE, and Infra-technical.
Priya: Example hooks OK to iterate on:
  PLG: "Ship chat faster: predictable latency + lower token spend across hosted and private."
  AE: "SLA-backed inference with private deployments and dedicated capacity — production ready."
  Infra-tech: "Batching, KV-caching, and quant kernels that preserve latency while cutting cost."
Dylan: On benchmark phrasing: avoid absolutes like "always" or "cheaper". Use comparative qualifiers and link to appendix. e.g., "Up to 4x lower unit cost in our benchmark under typical chat loads".
Hannah: Note: our staging config at 512 tokens showed median 22ms vs CVX median ~110ms on a similar GPU. Cost multipliers depend on quant & batching; I'll attach CSVs.
Omar: Rebut matrix should include these common objections: "We already have CloudVendor", "We need enterprise SLA", "We can't manage private infra". Provide 2-line rebut each.
Riley: Example rebut to "We already have CloudVendor": "They provide scale, but our runtime reduces per-token spend with automatic batching and prefix caching and offers migration paths to dedicated/private with consistent ops."
Priya: Inbound routing rule for demo requests: if body contains latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput -> tag: enterprise-sales. Otherwise -> growth-inbound. We'll pass to SDR ops to implement.
Dylan: Regex: /(latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput)/i. Also capture phrasing like "predictable" and "deterministic".
Hannah: Uploading bench charts and the raw logs to the pre-read doc now.
Omar: I'll sketch the one-slide competitor matrix: columns: claim, CVX, ManagedAPI, InfraVendor, Redwood. Rows: latency, unit cost, rollout friction, observability, private deploy, SLA.
Priya: Action items: Hannah -> bench graphs + appendix; Dylan -> cleaned benchmark language and appendix link; Omar -> rebut matrix and competitor slide; Riley -> three SDR hooks + A/B variants. I'll stitch the outputs and run the wargame.
launch-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent for 09:30-10:10 tomorrow to #marketing.
Riley: For SDR testing, propose 50-email micro-A/B (PLG vs Infra-tech) and capture responses for 72h.
Dylan: We'll also run a tiny landing experiment with a gating question "Need SLA or private deployment?" to triage leads.
Priya: Great. Keep the benchmark language conservative and link to appendix. Meet tomorrow, we'll lock copy and prep a one-pager for SDRs by Friday.
